Name: Neutral Floors and Paths
Author: Pixe1Moss
Description: [color=#d4d4d8] ## Description Neutral clean retexture for craftable floors and paths. Maintains the original vanilla art style, no extra decorative details added in the current release. Decorative themed variants are planned for future updates. ## Installation instructions 1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher. 2. Download this mod archive. 3. Unzip and place the `NeutralFloorsAndPaths` folder into your Stardew Valley `Mods` folder. 4. Launch the game via SMAPI. ## Main features ‑ Faithful natural texture edit for all craftable flooring and path tiles. ‑ Clean pixel‑aligned work based on original game sprites. ‑ Consistent visuals year‑round, prevents outdoor winter floors from reverting to vanilla snow texture. ## Requirements ‑ SMAPI ‑ Content Patcher ## Notes ‑ This mod replaces both base flooring and winter flooring game assets. ‑ Conflicts with other mods that overwrite `TerrainFeatures/Flooring`. ## Future Plans ‑ Decorative themed variants will be added in later updates. ## Shout outs Original sprite assets from Stardew Valley.[/color]
